fields.title: Wicked Witch: The Zero Trust Era
fields.description: A deep dive into modern cybersecurity frameworks. This seminar explores how Zero Trust architectures are redefining network safety in 2026. Join us for a hands-on look at threat mitigation and identity management.

fields.title: AI & Ethics: The 2026 Roadmap
fields.description: Explore the intersection of artificial intelligence and societal impact. This seminar covers bias in machine learning models and the regulatory landscape for AI in the upcoming year.

fields.title: Cloud-Native Infrastructure Summit
fields.description: Mastering Kubernetes and Docker at scale. Join our cloud experts for a session on building resilient, scalable systems that can handle modern global traffic.

fields.title: Modern API Design with Django
fields.description: Learn the best practices for building secure and efficient RESTful APIs. This workshop focuses on Django Rest Framework, authentication strategies, and performance optimization.

fields.title: Global Innovation Hackathon
fields.description: Empowering students to build the next generation of web applications. Participants will have 48 hours to create solutions using Django, Tailwind CSS, and modern API integrations. Prizes for top innovators!
